scope: Only TSFLab and Operon-S1; no new source collection, paid models, canonical updates or publication.
criteria_zh: 判断被更新的是可跨任务复用的外部指令/技能/工具/流程，是否受执行反馈驱动、经检查准入且保留。权重与 Harness 都迭代可为共演化；只更新权重、内容记忆或外部研究产物不因此成为 Harness RSI。

identity.official_abs_title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
identity.submission_history: Submission history From: ChengAo Shen [ view email ] [v1] Thu, 29 Oct 2026 19:22:33 UTC (1,137 KB)
identity.version_basis: Only v1 is listed in the official abs submission history; body fetched at the explicit v1 URL.

evidence.quote: without changing the model or harness
evidence.interpretation_zh: 作者把宿主 Agent harness 与外部 workbench 分开命名；不能忽略该限定，也不能只靠标题决定范围。

evidence.quote: Here, self-improvement means incorporating verified research outputs and fixes into the workbench’s shared resources and workflows so later agents can reuse them.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 范围应只取程序性 guidance/workflow/runner 修订，科研方法实现和知识资源本身不能都算 Harness。

evidence.quote: evaluation problems found during research sessions lead to revised guidance and runner checks; later sessions inherit these repairs.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 直接支持执行/评估反馈、可复用程序性工件修改和后续会话继承。

evidence.quote: Failed checks prompt revision and rechecking before integration, supporting workbench maintenance.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 修订必须通过复检再集成，不能把未经验证的输出等同于已保留工件。

evidence.quote: Continuous integration (CI) checks basic operations.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 可用性检查的实现；详细段落还说明运行、协议、配置一致性检查。

evidence.quote: An independent read-only review agent checks whether cards describe implementations and whether implementations preserve the defining mechanisms in papers and pinned official code, using papers alone when code is unavailable.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 独立只读复核是资源一致性检查；不把它自动解释为所有指令修订都获得提升检验。

evidence.quote: Additions and fixes from these tasks undergo the same checks, forming a shared update cycle that reduces repeated collection, implementation, and setup.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 说明跨后续研究任务反复维护的共享更新周期。

evidence.quote: Missing guidance, manual configuration, repeated log polling, and premature test access led to instruction and runner updates; all 17 initial usability failures were repaired before integration.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 正文报告实际 instruction 与 runner 更新；17 为原文数字，本审查未复算。

evidence.quote: although they do not isolate the effect of individual checks.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 不能把聚合性能或所有检查的作用独立归因到 Harness 演化。

evidence.quote: and workflows in .agents/skills/
evidence.interpretation_zh: 定位工作流工件；论文模型和单元所在目录另列，说明二者不可混淆。

evidence.section: Appendix A.2 Entry Instructions and Skills
evidence.quote: It states the workbench conventions, module interactions, resource access, and verification requirements.
evidence.interpretation_zh: AGENTS.md 的内容是流程/验证约束，不只是外部问题答案或领域知识卡片。

evidence.section: Appendix A.2 Entry Instructions and Skills
evidence.quote: Task-specific skills provide the steps, checks, and common pitfalls of each workflow and are loaded as needed.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 可复用任务步骤和检查属于程序性策略载体。

items.reason_zh: 建议收录其共享工作流/工具与指令修订机制：执行与评估暴露问题，Recursive Improver 促使 guidance、runner checks 和 instruction 更新，复检后进入共享 workbench，后续任务继承。目录中模型实现、知识卡片、预测结果本身不作为 Harness 纳入依据。

criteria.modified_object: procedural instructions/guidance and runner checks; AGENTS.md and skills establish the carrier layout, while exact changed-file diffs remain unverified

items.counterevidence_and_resolution_zh: §3.1 明说 workbench 不修改宿主 model/harness；按作者命名，CLI 宿主 harness 不变。Follow RSI 的对象判据还包括宿主外的可复用指令、工具和工作流策略；本例明确报告的 instruction/runner 更新满足这一程序性对象边界。附录 AGENTS.md/skills 用于定位程序性载体，不能据此声称已独立取得它们的逐文件修改 diff。也不能把所有知识资源、模型目录和科研产物维护都算作 Harness。
limits_zh: 这是原文支持的范围建议，不是对主表所有性能/费用提升归因到 Harness 自进化。
§4.4 直接承认未隔离各检查的影响；没有逐个修订版本的留出泛化或多代累计收益复算。
论文同时维护 TSF 模型代码、知识资源和科研产物；这些不全部属于 Harness。
只核验本次方法范围，不设置证据卡的 held_out/matched_budget/cross_model/cost 等正式字段。
当前未请求代码仓库或重跑 CI；程序性修改的具体文件 diff 未独立复现。
items.primary_review_delta_zh: 将 11/3 S2 摘要初筛的 workbench 边界项升级为 include 建议，因为正文给出了实际 instruction/runner 修订、复检和跨会话继承证据。
items.next_step_zh: 交独立审查核对 §3.5、§4.4 与附录 A 的程序性更新边界；即使意见一致也需保留正式审核和质量闸门，不能由本报告直接 accept。

items.title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents

identity.official_abs_title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
identity.submission_history: Submission history From: YueJie Hou [ view email ] [v1] Fri, 30 Oct 2026 07:07:09 UTC (7,826 KB)
identity.version_basis: Only v1 is listed in the official abs submission history; body fetched at the explicit v1 URL.

evidence.section: Results / Operon-S1 lifts the agent’s judgements into a separate decision layer
evidence.quote: All controllers share this policy and these messages and differ only in the distributions they return
evidence.interpretation_zh: 控制器对比固定 policy/messages，变化主要在决策模型输出分布。

evidence.section: Results / Operon-S1 lifts the agent’s judgements into a separate decision layer
evidence.quote: a message written in advance that may name a convention, a file or a quantity to verify.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 提示模板预先写好，未显示它在 gated rounds 中被自动改写。

evidence.section: Results / Gated retraining couples a data-synthesis pipeline with a promotion gate
evidence.quote: Each round runs the data-synthesis pipeline, which turns an executable curriculum into decisions with verifiable labels, mines hard examples from the parent version’s errors, trains a candidate, fits a temperature-scaling calibration
evidence.interpretation_zh: 明确反馈闭环存在；被训练和校准的是决策模型。

evidence.section: Results / Gated retraining couples a data-synthesis pipeline with a promotion gate
evidence.quote: A promoted version controls the agent and is the parent whose errors the next round mines, so each round starts from the last promoted version.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 版本保留与下一轮继承真实存在，但对象是模型检查点，不能混为 Harness 工件。

evidence.section: Results / Training raised accuracy on every decision question, and the gains carried over to the agent’s own states
evidence.quote: Because only the decision model changes, a trained version can be scored on the agent’s own decision states from the held-out halves, whose items training never drew on
evidence.interpretation_zh: 作者直接限定该训练评估中只有决策模型变化。

evidence.section: Results / Training raised accuracy on every decision question, and the gains carried over to the agent’s own states
evidence.quote: The quantity that training targets and the gate certifies is decision accuracy.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 发布 gate 认证决策准确率；不是 Harness 程序修改的验证。

evidence.section: Results / The seqqa2 baseline gain comes from a convention skill layer, measured apart from the decision layer
evidence.quote: r04b adds a general sequence-computation layer and a separately named convention layer for LAB-Bench to r03, together with a patch to the protocol-audit skill.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 必须承认外部技能版本有变化，不能声称全文完全没有 Harness 改动。

evidence.section: Results / The seqqa2 baseline gain comes from a convention skill layer, measured apart from the decision layer
evidence.quote: Skills were developed only on the development half of seqqa2, split by a hash of the item identifier, and the held-out half was tested once per release.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 技能开发与留出测试另行存在，但该段没有把它描述为本方法的系统自动生成/接纳/反馈迭代工件闭环。

evidence.quote: All controllers share the policy, thresholds and messages below
evidence.interpretation_zh: 控制策略、阈值和消息保持一致是实验设计；不能由变更推理输出推定它们也在自改。

evidence.quote: Models were fine-tuned from the public checkpoint with the vendor training tool
evidence.interpretation_zh: 确认候选更新涉及模型权重，不只是冻结模型外提示的改写。

evidence.quote: thresholds are not refitted.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 校准候选也不等于控制阈值自进化。

evidence.quote: An audit found that the first version of the gate could pass a candidate that learned only the label prior, before that version judged any candidate.
evidence.interpretation_zh: gate-rules@2 的修订发生在它评价候选前；不能据此补写为被评测的自动 Harness 元改进回路。

items.reason_zh: 建议不纳入当前 Harness RSI 专题。论文的反馈、hard-example mining、晋级与跨轮继承闭环都作用于 LAYA 决策模型检查点及校准；policy、thresholds 和 messages 固定。即使慢模型不变，更新外部小决策模型的权重也不等同于可复用 Harness 工件自改。

criteria.modified_object: fast decision model checkpoint and probability calibration

items.counterevidence_and_resolution_zh: r03→r04b 确实新增/修订技能并有留出测试，应承认这部分外部工件变化。论文把技能版本效应和决策层训练分开测量，正文未把技能的系统自动生成、验收、反馈修订与 LAYA gated rounds 联成共演化机制；不能因为同文出现技能修订就推定已验证 Harness RSI。gate-rules@2 也是开发审计后的修订，正文明确发生在该版本判断任何候选之前。
limits_zh: 排除依据是已报告自动改进回路的对象，不是“有权重训练就一律排除”；若原始新证据支持权重与外部工件联合迭代，可重判共演化。
没有声称全文不存在外部技能变更，相关 r03/r04b 证据已单列。
不把固定决策 Harness 的静态控制器对比重新命名为 Harness 自进化专项评测。
论文所述决策准确率与最终任务结果分开；本审查未复算任何实验数字或统计显著性。
未核查仓库代码、技能提交者或完整版本 diff；对于未描述的技能自动更新机制保持未确认。
items.primary_review_delta_zh: 官方正文确认了初筛中决策模型权重更新的主线，同时补录并处理了技能版本变化的反证；范围意见为 exclude，正式 decision 仍 defer。
items.next_step_zh: 独立复审重点检查 r03/r04b 技能开发和 gated training 是否有原文未覆盖的联动自动闭环；若无，可记录范围排除，保留一般模型 RSI/决策控制研究线索。

review_history_note_zh: 保留 new-source-screen.json/.md 的历史摘要初筛。本报告是主任务随后取得官方 abs 与正文后形成的范围纠正/确认，不回写此前初筛，不改变正式 defer，也不表示 Follow RSI 质量闸门已过。
